title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
text: We introduce Vision Transformer (ViT), which applies a pure transformer architecture directly to sequences of image patches for image classification. When pre-trained on large amounts of data and transferred to mid-sized or small benchmarks, ViT achieves excellent results compared to state-of-the-art convolutional networks.
text_summary: Vision Transformer applies pure transformer to image patches, achieving strong classification results.
